articles.title: India joins US-led 6G initiative with 25 countries: What new global alliance means for the future of internet and wireless connectivity
articles.description: India has joined a global coalition spearheaded by the United States to advance the development of 6G wireless technology. The partnership, which includes 25 nations, aims to align national strategies for 6G and ensure that next-generation networks reflect shared security interests. The initiative was discussed during the G20 Innovation Ministerial, while India has set an ambitious goal of becoming a leading contributor to 6G design, development and deployment by 2030.
